title: Source floor stack uses actual centroid projection and floor-only readiness
evidence: 2026-10-29 source-only component freeze in game/src/world/mbs_interior/floor_stack.gd and loop/singapore-fidelity/floor-stack/FROZEN_SOURCE.json; parent commit/native gate pending.
snippet: The new source floor stack is a component of the ongoing MBS goal, not a new four-hour pass. It projects actual tower centroid double arrays only after the common SourceFrame origin subtraction, copies real adjacent inventory elevation differences into recipes and exposes exact synchronous ready_for_floor {ready,floor_id,collision_generation,travel_ready:false}. Root must combine actual shaft/cabin proof and retain pins/unload guards. Mezzanine2.5m intervals require root partial platforms/vertical zones; missing resort anchors are transient mapping gaps, never permanent empty floors. See floor-stack/INTEGRATION.md. Native and whole-building verification remained pending at worker freeze.

title: Moving Godot doors must not receive source-floor support IDs
evidence: Actual mbssource floor-stack R1 checkpointacf0f805 completed94checks with2stable-support failures; R1_MOVING_SUPPORT_FAILURE.json and official Godot AnimatableBody3D class hierarchy. R2 source classification/QA pending native rerun.
snippet: On2026-10-29 native floor-stack R1 exposed that AnimatableBody3D inherits StaticBody3D, so a broad is-StaticBody3D filter incorrectly stamped rotating SwingDoors as persistent source-floor supports. Keep all doors in complete resident collision bodies, but stamp only the exact stable structural body. R2 also checks actual per-door metadata during native motion; its fresh native gate was pending at worker freeze. Do not infer support eligibility from base-class type or body counts alone.
